Package edu.harvard.hul.ois.fits.identity

Class FitsIdentity

  • java.lang.Object
    • edu.harvard.hul.ois.fits.identity.FitsIdentity
  • public class FitsIdentity
extends Object
    A non-tool-specific container for identification information about a file. Like ToolIdentity, it holds the format name, MIME type, and external identifiers, but it holds a list of identifying tools rather than a single one. It holds one format name and one MIME type, but can hold multiple versions where different tools disagree. Wraps file identity with the tool information that reported it
    Author:
    spmcewen
